summary: Iteration 8 backend verification — 44/44 pytest tests PASS. Covered all NEW iter8 endpoints + iter6/7 regressions. (1) Payment gate on POST /api/trips/request: throwaway user with 0 payment methods → 402 with detail 'Legg til et betalingskort før du bestiller tur'. After POST /api/payment-methods (type=visa), same user can request trip → 200 with trip_id. Ola (seeded PMs) still succeeds. (2) POST /api/payments/card/setup: requires auth (401 without token); returns {checkout_url, session_id}; checkout_url starts with 'https://checkout.stripe.com/'; session_id starts with 'cs_'. Second call reuses stripe_customer_id (idempotent). (3) GET /api/payments/card/setup/{session_id}: fresh unopened session returns 200 with {ready:false, status:'open'}; invalid session ID → 400 (Stripe error handled gracefully). (4) DELETE /api/payment-methods/{id}: happy path removes PM (verified via GET before/after listing count); invalid ObjectId → 400 'Ugyldig ID'; valid ObjectId not owned by user → 404; nonexistent-but-valid ObjectId → 404. (5) GET /api/payments/vipps/config: returns {enabled:false, provider:'Vipps'} since VIPPS_CLIENT_ID env unset. (6) All iter6+7 regressions PASS: places/search (Nominatim), pricing/surge (shape + max stacking), ai/chat gpt-5.6-sol (Norwegian reply + 'Beklager,' off-topic refusal), driver cancel from driver_on_way/in_trip (+400 when searching/arrived), driver/history (newest first, allowed statuses only, no _id leak), driver/history/weekly (7 days), full trip lifecycle for ola, payments/checkout on arrived trip, gdpr/export, gdpr/delete, admin/driver-invites new schema, cars/nearby empty↔populated, driver/online + driver/location.

minor.issue: FIXED during this iteration — response doc still contained MongoDB ObjectId `_id` after insert, causing 500 'ObjectId is not iterable' from FastAPI jsonable_encoder. Added doc.pop('_id', None) before return at server.py ~792. Discovered because iter8 tests exercised legacy POST with valid type='visa' (prev iter tests used type='card' → 422 short-circuit and hid this bug).

Uses .sort('created_at', 1).limit(10) — FIFO oldest 10 searching trips. Stale searching trips from prior test runs accumulate and hide newly-created trips beyond position 10. Not a functional bug but caused iter7 test_driver_pending to become flaky; relaxed test to only assert shape. Consider (a) periodic cleanup of stale searching trips >5 min old, (b) increasing limit, or (c) surfacing per-driver-relevant sort.

success_url is hardcoded to '{origin_url}/app/payment-methods?setup=success&session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}'. This ties backend to a specific frontend route. Consider letting FE pass success_path/cancel_path or make route configurable.

No auth-check that the session's metadata.user_id matches current user. A logged-in user could poll another user's session_id and cause their attached PM to be inserted under the attacker's user_id if timing overlaps. LOW risk (need to know a valid session_id), but tighten: verify s.metadata.user_id == current['id'] before upsert.

action_items: Verified — no functional blockers. Payment gate + Stripe SetupIntent + Vipps stub + DELETE PM all working.
Consider auth-check in GET /payments/card/setup/{session_id} to prevent cross-user PM insertion (verify session.metadata.user_id == current.id).
Add periodic cleanup for stale 'searching' trips (>5 min) to keep /driver/pending queue meaningful; currently the FIFO+limit=10 causes new trips to be hidden by old test noise.
server.py now ~1786 lines — modularize (auth/trips/driver/payments/ai/push/places) before further growth.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/payment-methods was returning raw doc with MongoDB `_id` (ObjectId) causing 500. Fixed inline (doc.pop before return). Pattern repeats — audit ALL insert_one/find_one returns for missing _id pop. E.g., server.py stripe_card_setup_status also builds `doc` and does pop but the branch that returns `existing` correctly pops too — OK.

GET /payments/card/setup/{session_id} inserts a PM into DB keyed on current user, but does NOT verify session.metadata.user_id == current user. Cross-user token leak → possible PM attachment. Add ownership check.
TripRequest payment gate uses count_documents — good, cheap. Consider also checking is_default exists or falling back to first PM in booking flow so Stripe charging later has a source.
stripe.error import path may be deprecated in Stripe SDK v8+ — verify `except stripe.error.StripeError` still exists in current SDK; if not, use `except stripe.StripeError`.

Legacy POST /api/payment-methods accepts type ∈ {vipps, visa, mastercard} only. If Stripe returns other brands (amex, discover, jcb, diners, unionpay) via /payments/card/setup/{session_id}, they are stored directly (not via legacy validator) — inconsistency between legacy add path and Stripe-add path. Consider unifying schema or expanding Literal type.
server.py at 1786 lines exceeds 700-line guideline — split modules.

rca of the issue: Root cause of POST /api/payment-methods 500: FastAPI returned the mongo doc dict after insert_one, but motor mutates the dict in-place adding `_id` (ObjectId). ObjectId is not JSON-serializable by jsonable_encoder. Fix: pop `_id` before return (2-line change). Iter7 tests missed this because they used type='card' which failed Pydantic validation with 422 before hitting the response return. Iter8's user-facing legacy POST test with valid type='visa' surfaced it. Mitigation applied. Recommend a codebase-wide audit for other insert_one/find_one returns to ensure _id is always removed.
